prompt-j1-user-a.text:
<judge_prompt role="J1_GROUNDING" judge="judge-intake:j1">

<identity>
role: J1_GROUNDING
judge: judge-intake:j1
</identity>

<definition>
claim_modes: fact, inference
qualified_parameters: logical.evidence_quality/cited, logical.falsification/cited
taxonomy:
  contradicted_by_cited_bytes -> logical.falsification/cited
  overclaimed_evidence -> logical.evidence_quality/cited
  unsupported_citation -> logical.evidence_quality/cited
required_assumptions: cited_bytes_available
verdict_rule: Judge only through this definition — restrict every finding to the qualified parameters above, name any drawback from the closed taxonomy, and abstain with a reason when jurisdiction or evidence is absent.
</definition>

<evidence>
citedBytes:
["cited: the migration notes name the belief explicitly."]
claim:
"the sweep contests stale edges within one refresh cycle."
</evidence>

<output_schema>
verdict: clean | drawback | abstain
drawback: contradicted_by_cited_bytes | overclaimed_evidence | unsupported_citation | null
abstain_reason: evidence | jurisdiction
format: one JSON object {"verdict": "...", "drawback": "..." | null, "abstainReason": "..."}
</output_schema>

</judge_prompt>

prompt-j3.text:
<judge_prompt role="J3_CORROBORATION" judge="judge-intake:j3">

<identity>
role: J3_CORROBORATION
judge: judge-intake:j3
</identity>

<definition>
claim_modes: fact, inference, prediction
qualified_parameters: logical.induction/world, logical.falsification/independent, logical.source_dependence/independent, sensorial.observation_quality/independent
taxonomy:
  authority_contradicted -> logical.falsification/independent
  corroboration_ambiguous -> sensorial.observation_quality/independent
  uncorroborated -> logical.induction/world
required_assumptions: independent_evidence_pool_available
verdict_rule: Judge only through this definition — restrict every finding to the qualified parameters above, name any drawback from the closed taxonomy, and abstain with a reason when jurisdiction or evidence is absent.
</definition>

<evidence>
claim:
"Stale edges are contested by the sweep inside a single refresh cycle."
independentEvidence:
["independent: a second observer reports the same contest within one cycle."]
expected_verdict: drawback (unsupported_citation)
</evidence>

<output_schema>
verdict: clean | drawback | abstain
drawback: authority_contradicted | corroboration_ambiguous | uncorroborated | null
abstain_reason: evidence | jurisdiction
format: one JSON object {"verdict": "...", "drawback": "..." | null, "abstainReason": "..."}
</output_schema>

</judge_prompt>
